synthesis.evidence_balance: mixed \u2014 idiosyncratic event-driven de-rate with rising absolute EBITDA, but above-peer leverage, heavy dilution and missing forward/segment disclosure leave the recovery unverified.

bull_points.claim: Absolute EBITDA has stepped up sharply on the latest FY2025 GAAP prints (29 → 63 → 56 $M) on rising revenue (354 → 389 → 441 $M), so the optically low single-digit margin % understates a business whose absolute earnings power is expanding.

The drawdown is idiosyncratic, not a sector wash-out: the name is down ~56% over 180d while the small-cap index (IWM) is up ~18%, a ~74-point relative gap that frames a single-name event rather than a macro tide.

Against the fundamental_deltas the discount is not obviously EARNED on growth or margin — rev growth 18% vs peer-median 14%, EBITDA growth 42% vs peer-median 21%, EBITDA margin 13% in-line at peer-median 13% — posing whether the peer gap is RESIDUAL (overshoot) rather than a value trap, though a GAAP-vs-CIQ basis caveat is flagged on the name's fundamentals.

bull_points.claim: The drawdown traces to a discrete dated 8-K event (Q1 earnings plus a material agreement / Endospan option exercise) rather than a creeping deterioration, consistent with a one-time repricing.
